anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: System pressure dropped abruptly from ~649 mbar to ~392-400 mbar at k=19
Buffer-vessel dP jumped from ~2 to ~6.5-6.9 mbar
Column dP collapsed from ~1.0 to ~0.34-0.38 mbar
Distillate flow fell to ~0.005 while reflux FT704 spiked to ~1.3-1.5

args.missing_evidence: Column/reboiler temperatures are not installed; need vacuum-system/valve status, condenser and takeoff valve positions, and a leak/pressure-hold test to distinguish a seal leak or pressure-control step change from a takeoff blockage.
